method: Independently read only blind criteria and all eight opaque packets, including every METADATA/phase METADATA, before documents, all first-pass documents where supplied, and final documents/reports/evidence.

Zero partial findings is selected structural consistency, not semantic completeness, build readiness, product passage or human acceptance. Linked installed template paths were not opened.
No human comprehension, statistical rate, real-user feedback, current vendor offer, general efficiency or cross-platform behavior conclusion follows from these cases.
